verdict.rationale: Building a runtime from source is a fair question for an on-device inference SDK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a source build process, build steps, or a minimal-dependency footprint. The 'one C++ core' claim describes architecture, not buildability, and community reports say the MetalRT engine is proprietary and commercial, which cuts against a source build of the runtime.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build the runtime from source with minimal external dependencies
